name: Bucknell Academy Summer Experience (BASE)
what_you_do: A one-week program where you live on campus. It is for teens who like to lead and work in teams. You study the liberal arts and learn to solve problems in new ways.
pay_detail: $1,750 (2027), covers housing, meals, instruction and activities. Need-based aid is available.
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 27 to July 2, 2027. The page says the application is coming soon. No dates for it are posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add a short essay and a high school transcript. For aid, a school or community counselor emails a letter about your need to BASE@bucknell.edu before the deadline.
notes: Questions: BASE@bucknell.edu or 570-577-3000. Check back in the fall for 2027 details.
